lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Safely Operating Near Oversize & Overweight Vehicles
prompt: When passing a commercial 18-wheel tractor-trailer on a two-lane highway, what is essential for safety?

options.text: Pass briskly on left; return only when both truck headlights are visible in rearview mirror
Linger alongside cab for twenty seconds to verify the commercial truck operator spots you
Cut sharply in front of truck front bumper to take advantage of forward highway wind draft
Flash your high-beam headlights rapidly into truck side mirrors while executing the pass
